headline: Dave Eggers tells OpenAI staff ChatGPT is silencing a generation
summary: Author Dave Eggers, invited by Sam Altman, criticized ChatGPT's impact on education and writing, stating it "stole their voice" and made teachers' lives "catastrophic."
details: Author Dave Eggers, known for his critiques of the tech industry, addressed OpenAI staff at Sam Altman's invitation. Instead of offering career advice, Eggers delivered a strong rebuke of ChatGPT's impact.
According to the Financial Times, Eggers told the employees that ChatGPT's effect on educators has been "catastrophic," making their jobs infinitely more difficult.
He expressed concern that if students use AI to compose, they will never learn to write properly. Eggers believes this hinders their ability to develop their own voice and tell their own stories.
Eggers' critique suggests that AI tools like ChatGPT risk "silencing an entire generation or two" by preventing the development of essential writing skills and personal expression.
caption:
Dave Eggers, invited to speak at OpenAI, didn't hold back his criticism of ChatGPT.

Author Dave Eggers, known for his critiques of the tech industry, addressed OpenAI staff at Sam Altman's invitation. Instead of offering career advice, Eggers delivered a strong rebuke of ChatGPT's impact.

According to the Financial Times, Eggers told the employees that ChatGPT's effect on educators has been "catastrophic," making their jobs infinitely more difficult.

He expressed concern that if students use AI to compose, they will never learn to write properly. Eggers believes this hinders their ability to develop their own voice and tell their own stories.

Eggers' critique suggests that AI tools like ChatGPT risk "silencing an entire generation or two" by preventing the development of essential writing skills and personal expression.

Source: The Verge
